The script captures runtime output live, printing it locally while sending each line with a prefix (STDOUT or STDERR) to the remote server via a persistent socket connection.

Note: I was unable to push the commit due to a TLS connection error with the remote git server. Please verify repository remote settings and network access, or push the commit manually if needed.

You can run the diagnostic script like this from the repo root:

```bash
python3 diagnostic_logging.py add 28.50 --category food --note lunch
```

This will forward the live CLI output to your server as well as print it locally.
